description_en: The E-commerce AI Video Generation Agent is designed for e-commerce merchants and platforms. Based on product main images, titles, selling points, and other information, it automatically generates 5–30 second product showcase short videos, helping customers efficiently produce and distribute e-commerce content. The product supports multiple resolution outputs such as 720P and 1080P, supports both single-product quick calls and multi-product batch generation, catering to both daily operations and large-scale product content production needs. Currently, it covers all apparel categories (tops, pants, skirts, suits, underwear, swimwear, etc.) and is gradually expanding to skincare, cosmetics, food and beverages, home appliances, and other core e-commerce categories
description_zh: 电商AI视频生成Agent面向电商商家与平台，基于商品主图、标题、卖点等信息，自动生成 5–30 秒商品展示短视频，帮助客户高效完成电商内容生产与分发。产品支持 720P、1080P 等多种清晰度输出，支持单商品快速调用与多商品批量生成，兼顾日常运营和大规模商品内容生产需求。当前已覆盖服饰全品类（上衣、裤装、裙装、套装、内衣、泳装等），逐步拓展至护肤品、化妆品、食品饮料、家用电器等电商核心类目
name: VideoGeneration

fields.help_en: The list of product image URLs (1 to 6 images). The URLs must be publicly accessible
fields.help_zh: 商品图 URL 列表（1~6 张），需公网可访问
fields.name: images

fields.example: 2026 New Slimming Women's Summer Dress with Mid-Length Design, High-Quality Waist Definition for a Slender Look
fields.help_en: The product title. A maximum of the first 60 characters are used
fields.help_zh: 商品标题，最多截取前 60 个字符
fields.name: title

fields.help_en: The video duration in seconds. Currently supports integers between 5 and 15. More options will be available in the future
fields.help_zh: 视频时长（秒），当前支持 5–15 秒之间的整数，后续扩展
fields.name: duration

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of success indicates a successful call, and a value of failed indicates a failure
Code.description_zh: 响应代码。success 代表调用成功，failed 代表失败
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The struct of the returned result
Data.description_zh: 返回结果的结构体信息

additionalProperties.description_en: The video duration and video resolution
additionalProperties.description_zh: 视频时长和视频分辨率

Message.description_en: The response message. An error message is returned if the call fails
Message.description_zh: 返回信息，失败时返回错误信息
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to identify a unique request call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success, and a value of false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否成功。true 代表成功，false 代表失败
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
